status: Authorized map-agreement design; freeze conditional on unchanged coverage and verified sources

selection.population: Checksum-pinned official metadata.parquet: 480038 clean-catalog rows; no extra label or quality filtering
selection.ordering: Within each country, SHA256(seed|tile) orders tiles; round-robin tiles, each ordered by SHA256(seed|patch_id) then patch_id
selection.enrichment: Equal country quotas and tile spreading, not proportional or globally representative sampling
selection.stop: Exactly this predeclared 2000-ID feasibility step; local archives only, no replacements, repeated draws or new text requests

spatial.source: Verified native RGB/map footprints transformed with densified bounds; catalog ID substrings alone are not coordinate evidence
spatial.grouping: Connected components of footprint overlap or bounding-box distance <= 2000 m; all acquisition dates participate
spatial.assignment: Any component containing a previous development ID is development; other complete components use SHA256(seed|group_id) / 2**256 < test_fraction
spatial.unverified: Unassigned; never silently allocated to final test

coverage.rationale: Ten positives avoid a structural P@10 ceiling below one; ten negatives and N>10 avoid a trivial all-positive or prevalence-only task. Cluster-removal checks require dispersed positive evidence; both-present relation negatives are indispensable. These are feasibility gates, not a power guarantee. Fixed using reference-based development limitations, without model results.

evaluation.main_candidates: All verified test-split IDs, independent of query relevance; no relevance filtering
evaluation.controls: Separate filtered additional experiment per adjacency intent: both class presence states must be true; retain unknown relation states and report excluded false/unknown presence counts
evaluation.precision: sum relevance at ranks 1..10 / 10; undefined for N<10
evaluation.average_precision: sum over positive ranks of precision-at-rank / total positives; undefined for zero positives
evaluation.unknown: Any unknown in a candidate collection makes its main metrics undefined; never encode unknown as false. Retain full rankings and coverage. Separately labelled judged-only diagnostics compress fixed rankings; precision denominator min(10, judged count). No global or query-specific exclusions from main retrieval.
evaluation.ties: Descending exact cosine similarity, then ascending full Unicode patch ID
evaluation.paraphrases: Arithmetic mean of all formulations within each fixed intent; no NaN skipping. Report each formulation and max-minus-min quality range separately.
evaluation.weighting: Equal weight per fixed intent, not per formulation or per family; overall mean of eight intent means; separate single/conjunction/adjacency blocks. Controls reported separately, never pooled with main.
evaluation.pairing: RemoteCLIP minus CLIP on identical candidates, intents and formulations

bootstrap.unit: Direct intent family, preserving all its intents, paraphrases and both model scores
bootstrap.draw: G families sampled uniformly with replacement per replicate; retain repeated family occurrences
bootstrap.estimate: Sum sampled intent differences / number of sampled intents; same equal-intent weighting as point estimate
bootstrap.undefined: No silently discarded replicates or intents; report undefined blocks and reasons
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional robustness across the two predefined direct families; few families cannot support broad uncertainty or geographic generalization claims

evaluation.paraphrase_jaccard: All unordered pairs of top-10 patch-ID sets within each intent/model; |intersection|/|union|; report separately from quality means

error_analysis.formulations: p1 for every fixed intent, both models
error_analysis.selection: These exact ranks after frozen evaluation, no score-driven replacement; identify repeated images explicitly
error_analysis.categories: Satisfied; single presence failure; for composites class-a-only/class-b-only/neither; both-present relation failure; unknown reference. Three-state disjoint classification; unknown only when relevance cannot be decided. Manual map/RGB disagreement is a separate annotation, never a label overwrite.

changes: Any future frozen input/specification change requires a new version and reason; changes motivated by final test results are exploratory

estimand.main: Agreement with generalized CLC2018 map reference under reference-rules-v1
estimand.adjacency: Both class presences and >=60 m summed four-neighbor mapped contact; not independently verified visible-object adjacency
estimand.source_generalization: CLC2018: 25-ha minimum mapping unit and 100-m minimum linear feature width; clipping does not enforce a 25-ha per-patch minimum
estimand.visual_diagnosis: RGB/map disagreements are qualitative Development diagnostics, never automatic reference edits
estimand.original_text: Optional source annotation; missing captions do not block main retrieval if independent image/catalog/map identities and geometry are verified; caption analyses use actual texts only
estimand.suitability_requirement: Class aggregation, full-patch area bounds and mapped contact calculation must agree with documented CLC semantics; technical alignment alone is insufficient

revision_reason: Explicit user authorization: map-agreement estimand, optional original captions, one fixed 2000-ID expansion; all numerical coverage, reference/query rules, spatial and analysis protocols unchanged
